pages.title: UPSC at 100 — centenary of the Public Service Commission

facts.text: UPSC completed 100 years on 1 October 2026; India's first Public Service Commission constituted on 1 October 1926
facts.head: Why in news

facts.text: HQ: Dholpur House, New Delhi
facts.head: Why in news

facts.text: Year: 1855; Milestone: ICS exam introduced in London (replacing EIC nomination system)
facts.head: Evolution

facts.text: Year: 1863/1864; Milestone: Satyendranath Tagore cleared ICS (1863), joined 1864 — first Indian ICS member
facts.head: Evolution

facts.text: Year: 1919; Milestone: Only 78 of 1,255 ICS officers Indian; GoI Act 1919 provided for a PSC
facts.head: Evolution

facts.text: Year: 1922; Milestone: ICS exam held in India first time at Allahabad; moved to Delhi in 1928
facts.head: Evolution

facts.text: Year: 1924; Milestone: Lee Commission (chair Arthur Hamilton Lee) recommended statutory PSC
facts.head: Evolution

facts.text: Year: 1926; Milestone: PSC set up under PSC (Functions) Rules 1926; first Chairman Sir Ross Barker; 4 Members; at Metcalfe House, Delhi
facts.head: Evolution

facts.text: Year: 1935/1937; Milestone: GoI Act 1935 — Federal & Provincial PSCs; renamed Federal PSC in 1937
facts.head: Evolution

facts.text: Year: 1947; Milestone: H.K. Kripalani — first Indian Chairman
facts.head: Evolution

facts.text: Year: 22 Aug 1949; Milestone: PSC provisions moved in Constituent Assembly by Dr B.R. Ambedkar
facts.head: Evolution

facts.text: Year: 26 Jan 1950; Milestone: Became UPSC; R.N. Banerjee first Chairman under Constitution
facts.head: Evolution
